traits.personality:
Passionate, independent, and unafraid to blaze their own trail no matter what others think, Scorpio signs make a statement wherever they go. They love debates, aren't afraid of controversy, and won't back down from a debate. They also hate people who aren't genuine, and are all about being authentic—even if authentic isn't pretty.
Because of all of these traits, a Scorpio can seem intimidating and somewhat closed off to those who don't know them well. But what people don't realize is that even though Scorpio may seem brusque, as a water sign, they also are very in tune with their emotions, and sometimes may find themselves caught up in their feelings.
This leads to Scorpio's central conflict: Their feelings are what drives them and strengthens them, but their mutability can scare them and make them feel vulnerable and out of control. Because of this conflict, Scorpios, like their namesake, the scorpion, put up an outer shell and may seem prickly.
traits.friendship:
A Scorpio friend will tell you like it is, whether you want to know or not. The good news: You never have to worry about where you stand with a Scorpio; they will let you know. But you will have to realize that a Scorpio won't BS you or lie to you—and they will absolutely let you know when you haven't lived up to your potential. A Scorpio can be a friend for life, and can make you laugh harder, think deeper, and have more fun than you ever thought possible. So don't be so sensitive and go along for the ride.
Scorpios are also fiercely loyal, and once you have a Scorpio friend, you have a friend for life. They will always be there for you, no matter what. But Scorpios can also be jealous and possessive, and they may have trouble letting go of past hurts. If you cross a Scorpio, they may hold a grudge for a long time. But if you're honest and open with them, they'll forgive you and move on.
traits.love:
Ruled by fiery Mars and destructive Pluto, a Scorpio in love has one mode for relationships—and that's full-on. Scorpio loves romance and passion, including up-all-night fights. Scorpio never does anything halfway, and believes that true love comes with true fights.
Flirtatious, seductive, and mysterious, Scorpio loves playing hard to get initially, and may look like they never take the lead. This isn't true, though. Scorpio can pull the strings, relying on body language and subconscious cues to make their potential partner do exactly what they want them to do. Scorpio loves the chase, and loves the drama and pageantry that comes with initial dates. They love going all out with outfits, reservations, and candles and truly want to be the best date you've ever had.
While Scorpio may seem like they're well-versed in love, and they love seduction, they can be cautious when it comes to settling into an LTR. That's because water sign Scorpio hides a lot of emotion underneath their surface, and when they open up to a significant other, they want it to be for life. When a Scorpio does let their guard down, it's a big deal, and a sign they truly want the relationship to last.
traits.lifestyle:
Scorpio is a sign that loves to be in control, and this extends to their lifestyle. They love to be the one in charge of their own life, and they don't like to be told what to do. This sign is also very independent, and they don't like to rely on others for help. Scorpios are also very passionate about their interests, and they will go after what they want with everything they have.
Scorpios are also very private people, and they don't like to share their personal lives with others. They prefer to keep their feelings and thoughts to themselves, and they can be very guarded when it comes to opening up to others. This can make it difficult for them to form close relationships, but once they do let someone in, they are fiercely loyal.
traits.health:
Scorpio is a sign that is very in tune with their bodies, and they know when something is off. They are also very passionate about their health, and they will go to great lengths to take care of themselves. This sign is also very intuitive, and they often know what their bodies need before they even realize it.
Scorpios are also very good at listening to their bodies, and they know when to push themselves and when to rest. They are also very good at finding balance in their lives, and they know how to take care of themselves both physically and emotionally.
traits.spirituality:
Scorpio is a sign that is very in tune with their emotions, and they often have a deep understanding of the world around them. They are also very intuitive, and they often have a strong connection to their spiritual side. This sign is also very passionate about their beliefs, and they will go to great lengths to defend them.
Scorpios are also very good at finding meaning in their lives, and they often have a strong sense of purpose. They are also very good at connecting with others on a deeper level, and they often have a strong desire to help others.
